scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @nexus/server" "npm run dev -w @nexus/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:server && npm run build:web
scripts.build:server: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/server
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @nexus/shared && npm run build -w @nexus/web
scripts.typecheck: npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @nexus/server && npm run lint -w @nexus/web
